title: Syslog

fields.name: mode
fields.description: Defines transport protocol mode: unix_udp (UDP over Unix socket), unix_tcp (TCP over Unix socket), tcp or udp

fields.name: listen
fields.description: If Mode is set to tcp or udp, specify the network interface to bind.

fields.name: port
fields.description: If Mode is set to tcp or udp, specify the TCP port to listen for incoming connections.

fields.name: path
fields.description: If Mode is set to unix_tcp or unix_udp, set the absolute path to the Unix socket file.

fields.name: unix_perm
fields.description: If Mode is set to unix_tcp or unix_udp, set the permission of the Unix socket file.

fields.name: parser
fields.description: Specify an alternative parser for the message.

fields.name: buffer_chunk_size
fields.description: By default the buffer to store the incoming Syslog messages, do not allocate the maximum memory allowed, instead it allocate memory when is required.

fields.name: buffer_max_size
fields.description: Specify the maximum buffer size to receive a Syslog message.

fields.name: receive_buffer_size
fields.description: Specify the maximum socket receive buffer size.

fields.name: source_address_key
fields.description: Specify the key where the source address will be injected.

fields.name: threaded
fields.description: Indicates whether to run this input in its own [thread](/manual/3.2/administration/multithreading.md#inputs).

fields.name: tag
fields.description: Tag assigned to records emitted by this input plugin.

description: Syslog input plugins allows to collect Syslog messages through a Unix socket server (UDP or TCP) or over the network using TCP or UDP.
